n-k-k5-01.title: Ma ogeysiisku wuu taageeraa Minseo?
n-k-k5-01.goal: Hubi sheegasho saaxiib iyadoo la barbardhigayo shuruud kasta oo ogeysiis ah, ma aha kan koowaad oo keliya, oo sharax natiijada af Kuuriyaan.
n-k-k5-01.material:
Ogeysiis online ah oo dukaan iyo fariin saaxiibkaa Minseo. Maanta waa July 12.

[여름맞이 이벤트 안내]
- 기간: 7월 1일 ~ 7월 15일
- 이벤트 기간에 3만 원 이상 사시면 배송비가 무료입니다.
- 제주·도서산간 지역은 무료 배송 대상이 아닙니다. (배송비 3,000원)
- 할인 쿠폰은 한 번만 쓸 수 있습니다.

민서의 문자: "나 어제 4만 원어치 샀어! 배송비 무료래. 제주도에 계신 우리 할머니 댁으로 보냈는데 잘됐지?"
n-k-k5-01.thinking.0: Kala qaybinta sheegasho shuruudo gooni ah
n-k-k5-01.thinking.1: Hubinta shuruud kasta oo caddayn ah
n-k-k5-01.prereq.0: Wuu akhriyi karaa 이상, 제외, -(으)면 iyo ogeysiisyo gaaban
n-k-k5-01.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan tirooyinka sida 만 원 iyo 삼천 원
n-k-k5-01.prereq.2: Wuu yaqaan 도서산간 = jasiiraduhu fog iyo meelaha buuraleyda ah
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.prompt: Si loo go'aamiyo haddii sheegashada Minseo run tahay, khaduyaasha ogeysiiska waa inaad la barbardhigtaa fariintiisa? Dooro dhammaan kuwa muhiimka ah.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Xaqiiqooyinka fariinta Minseo kuwee ayuu ogeysiisku ka hadlaa? Raadi khad mid kasta.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.1: Khad kasta oo ogeysiiska ah, weydii: ma dejinayaa shuruud gaarsiin bilaash ah?
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.a: Xeerka kuuboonka wuxuu ku saabsan yahay dhimis. Sheegashada Minseo waxay ku saabsan tahay khidmadda gaarsiinta, sidaa darteed khadkani ma go'aamiyo.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.explain: Sheegashadeedu waxay leedahay saddex qaybood: goorta ay iibsatay (muddada dhacdada), intee (30,000 won ama ka badan) iyo meesha loo diray (xeerka aagga). Qayb kasta waxaa daboolaya hal khad; khadka kuuboonku ma ku saabsana gaarsiinta.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.prompt: Ma ogeysiisku wuu taageeraa sheegashada Minseo ee ah in gaarsiintiisu bilaash tahay?
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qaado shuruudaha ogeysiiska mid mid oo mid kasta ku calaamadee fariintiisa.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Shuruudee ayaadan weli ku hubin fariintiisa?
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.a: Haa, laakiin kaliya haddii ay sidoo kale isticmaashay kuuboonka dhimista hal mar.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.a: Kuuboonku waa bixin gooni ah; ma aha shuruud gaarsiin bilaash ah.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.b: Ma la sheegi karo, sababtoo ah Minseo keliya ayaa og intay runtii bixisay.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.b: Xaddigu wuxuu ku jiraa fariintiisa, ogeysiisku wuxuu magacaabaa gobollada uu ka reebay, sidaa darteed go'aan waa suurtagal.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.c: Haa. Waxay iibsatay 40,000 won inta lagu jiray dhacdada, sidaa darteed gaarsiintu waa bilaash.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.c: Waxay hubisay taariikhda iyo xaddiga, laakiin halkaas way joogsatay. Ogeysiisku wuxuu leeyahay shuruud kale oo ku saabsan meesha xirmada tagayso.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.d: Maya. Ogeysiisku ma bixiyo gaarsiin bilaash ah aagga ay u dirtay.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.explain: Gaarsiin bilaash ah waxay u baahan tahay muddada dhacdada IYO 30,000 won ama ka badan IYO aag gaarsiin oo aan laga reebin. Minseo waxay buuxisay labada ugu horreeya, laakiin ogeysiisku wuxuu ka reebayaa 제주·도서산간. Buuxinta shuruudda koowaad ma ka dhigto sheegashada mid run ah.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.prompt: U jawaab Minseo af Kuuriyaan (hadal saaxiibtinimo -요). Dheh waxaad u malaynayso khidmadda gaarsiinteeda oo sii sababta ogeysiiska. Ingiriis waa la aqbalaa haddii aad ku xirnaato.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ku bilow meesha, kadibna sheeg waxa ogeysiisku ka sheegayo meeshaas.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ku dhammee waxa Minseo ay filan karto inay bixiso.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma magacaabay shuruudda Minseo ay seegtay (aagga)?
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma ku saleeyay ogeysiiska, ma aha qiyaasteyda oo keliya?
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.model.2: Waxaan u malaynayaa inaanay bilaash ahayn: ogeysiisku wuxuu leeyahay Jeju lagama mid ah, sidaa darteed waxaa laga yaabaa khidmad 3,000 won ah.

n-k-k5-03.thinking.2: Helista in ka badan hal xal
n-k-k5-03.title: Ballan buuxinaya xeer kasta
n-k-k5-03.topic: dhowr shuruud isla mar, mid ka mid ah oo erayada ku qarsoon
n-k-k5-03.goal: U beddel ogeysiis leh xeer taban shuruudo sax ah, ka hel dhowr ballan oo dhammaantood qancinaya, oo hal ku warbixi af Kuuriyaan.
n-k-k5-03.material:
Waxaad qaadanaysaa xaflad shaqo oo madxaf qoyskaaga. Ogeysiiska madxafka iyo qoraalka eedadaa:

[가족 체험 예약 안내]
- 요금: 어른 1명 8,000원, 어린이 1명 5,000원
- 한 번에 4명 이상 6명 이하까지 예약할 수 있습니다.
- 어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다.
- 어린이는 1명 이상 있어야 합니다.

이모 문자: "예산은 4만 원까지예요."
n-k-k5-03.thinking.0: Akhrinta xeer taban si sax ah (적으면 안 되다)
n-k-k5-03.prereq.0: Wuu yaqaan tirooyinka, 명, 원 iyo 이상 / 이하
n-k-k5-03.prereq.1: Wuu la kulmay -(으)면 안 되다 iyo -보다
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.prompt: Ogeysiisku wuxuu leeyahay '어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다.' Ballamaha kuwee ayuu xeerkani oggolaadaa?
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.0: U tarjun xeerka xeer ku saabsan dadka waaweyn: 'dadka waaweyn waa inaanay ahayn ... carruurta'.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.1: Qor xeerka sida barbardhig u dhexeeya tirada dadka waaweyn iyo tirada carruurta, kadibna ku tijaabi xaaladaha labada tiro ay kala duwan yihiin iyo kuwa isla mid yihiin.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.a: Dad waaweyn sida carruurta oo kale, oo aan isku-darro kale jirin.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.a: Xeerku wuxuu mamnuucayaa kaliya dad waaweyn YAR. Dad waaweyn oo badan sidoo kale waa fiican.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.b: Dad waaweyn sida carruurta oo kale, ama dad waaweyn oo ka badan carruurta.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.c: Dad waaweyn oo ka badan carruurta; isla tiro lama oggola.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.c: Tirooyin siman ma aha 'dad waaweyn oo yar', sidaa darteed waa la oggol yahay.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.d: Carruur ka badan dadka waaweyn; isla tiro lama oggola.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.d: Taasi waa ka soo horjeedka xeerka.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.explain: '적으면 안 되다' macnaheedu waa 'waa inaanay yarayn'. Sidaa darteed dad waaweyn >= carruur: dad waaweyn oo badan waa fiican yihiin iyo isla tiro waa fiican tahay, laakiin dad waaweyn oo yar maaha.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.prompt: Ka hel 3 ballan oo kala duwan oo raacaya xeer kasta oo ogeysiiska ah iyo miisaaniyadda fariinta. a = tirada dadka waaweyn, c = tirada carruurta.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.0: Liis garee xeerarka sida shuruudo gaaban oo ku saabsan a iyo c ka hor intaadan tirooyin tijaabin.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tijaabi hal ballan oo ku hubi xeer kasta isku xigta; haddii hal xeer fashilmo, beddel a ama c oo mar kale hubi.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.2: Lacagta ugu dambayn hubi: 8,000 x a + 5,000 x c.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 어린이는 1명 이상 있어야 합니다: ugu yaraan hal ilmo.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c2: 어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다: dadka waaweyn waa inaanay ka yarayn carruurta.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c3: 4명 이상: ugu yaraan 4 qof wadar ahaan.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c4: 6명 이하: ugu badnaan 6 qof wadar ahaan.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c5: Wadarta waxay ka badan tahay 40,000 won (8,000 qof weyn kasta, 5,000 ilmo kasta).
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.explain: Shan ballan ayaa ku habboon: (3 qof oo waaweyn, 1 ilmo) 29,000 won; (2, 2) 26,000 won; (4, 1) 37,000 won; (3, 2) 34,000 won; (3, 3) 39,000 won. Ogeysiisku iyo fariintu waxay bixiyaan xadadyo, ma aha hal dalab oo sax ah.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Dooro HAL ka mid ah ballamahaaga oo codsiga ugu qor madxafka af Kuuriyaan (edeb leh -요): intee qof oo weyn, intee carruur, iyo qiimaha guud.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ku bilow tirada dadka waaweyn, kadibna carruurta.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Wadarta ugu dambayn sheeg oo ku dhammee -요.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma tirooyinka waxay la mid yihiin hal ballan oo aan dhisay?
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma wadartu waa sax (8,000 qof weyn kasta + 5,000 ilmo kasta)?

n-k-k5-02.title: Hayun wuxuu gudbiyaa erayada macallinka
n-k-k5-02.topic: gudbinta erayada qof kale adigoo aan qaloocin
n-k-k5-02.goal: Barbardhig fariin la gudbiyay iyo asalkeeda, ka hel khaduyaasha macnaha beddelay, oo ku hagaaji hadal la sheegay.
n-k-k5-02.material:
Macallinku wuxuu ku siiyay ogeysiiskan fasalka maanta (Salaasa). Hayun fasalka ayuu ku jiray. 민수 ma joogin oo wuxuu weydiiyay waxa macallinku yiri, sidaa darteed Hayun wuxuu u qoray galabtaas. (-대 / -래 macnaheedu waa 'waan maqlay in ...': waxay gudbiyaan erayada qof kale. 벼룩시장 = suuq alaab la isticmaalay.)

[선생님 말씀]
"토요일 학교 벼룩시장은 비가 오면 체육관에서 합니다. 물건은 한 사람이 다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요. 가격표는 학교에서 준비하니까 안 만들어 와도 돼요. 아침 9시 30분까지 체육관에 물건을 가져다 놓으세요. 팔고 남은 물건은 집에 가져가세요. 참가 신청서는 목요일까지 내세요."
n-k-k5-02.thinking.1: Kala saarista xad, shuruud iyo ogolaansho
n-k-k5-02.thinking.2: Ilaalinta tirooyinka iyo maalmaha si sax ah
n-k-k5-02.prereq.0: Wuu la kulmay -대요 / -래요 / -라고 했어요 (hadal la sheegay)
n-k-k5-02.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan -까지 sida xad iyo -아/어야 하다
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.prompt: Qoraalka Hayun waa inuu gudbiyaa si sax ah waxa macallinku yiri. Dhowr khad ayaa beddelay macnaha macallinka. Dooro mid ka mid ah.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qaado fariinta macallinka weedh weedh oo ka hel khadka u dhigma qoraalka Hayun.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.1: Lammaane kasta, barbardhig tirooyinka, maalmaha iyo haddii macnuhu yahay 'karaa', 'waa inuu' ama 'looma baahna'.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.explain: Khaduyada 3, 5 iyo 7 waa khalad. Khadka 3 wuxuu u beddelaa 'ilaa shan' (다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요) 'waa inuu iibiyaa shan'. Khadka 5 wuxuu beddelaa 9:30 una beddelaa 8:30. Khadka 7 wuxuu beddelaa wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah Khamiista ilaa Jimcaha. Khaduyada kale waxay la mid yihiin erayada macallinka.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.prompt: Nuqulkee khadka 3 ayaa gudbiya waxa macallinku yiri ee ku saabsan tirada alaabta?
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore sheeg weedhda macallinka ee ku saabsan alaabta erayadaaga: ma shanta waa ugu badnaan, ugu yaraan mise tiro sax ah?
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.1: Doorasho kasta ku tijaabi macnahaas oo barbardhig dhammaadyada (-아/어야 하다 iyo -(으)ㄹ 수 있다).
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.b: Tani waxay leedahay waa inaad iibiso shan sax ah. Macallinku wuxuu bixiyay xad, ma aha tiro loo baahan yahay.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.c: 이상 wuxuu xadka ka dhigaa ugu yaraan, taas oo ka soo horjeedda 'ilaa shan'.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.d: Tani waxay leedahay iibintu gabi ahaanba lama oggola; macallinku wuxuu oggolaaday ilaa shan.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.explain: '다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요' (waad iibin kartaa ilaa shan) waxaa loo gudbiyaa sida '다섯 개까지 팔 수 있대'. Ugu badnaan, ugu yaraan iyo tiro sax ah waa saddex fariin oo kala duwan.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.prompt: Qor nuqulada la sixay ee khadka 5 (waqtiga alaabta la keenayo) iyo khadka 7 (wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah ee foomka) af Kuuriyaan sida Hayun ugu diri lahaa 민수 (isla galabtaas, isagoo gudbinaya erayada macallinka).
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ka koobi tirooyinka iyo maalinta fariinta macallinka, ma aha qoraalka Hayun.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.hint.1: Isticmaal hadal la sheegay (tusaale ahaan -대/-래 ama -라고 했어), sida khaduyada saxda ah.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma labada weedhood waxay u dhammaadaan sida hadal la sheegay (-대/-래/-라고 했어)?
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma 민수 wuxuu imaan lahaa waqtigii oo foomka siin lahaa maalinta saxda ah?

n-k-k5-04.title: Maalinteed ayaa wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah?
n-k-k5-04.topic: aan-caddaan fariin wakhti kama dambays ah
n-k-k5-04.goal: Si dhow u akhri fariin wakhti kama dambays ah, dooro su'aasha go'aaminaysa waxa aad sameyn karto, oo si edeb leh u qor su'aashaas.
n-k-k5-04.material:
Maanta waa Isniin, 11월 2일. Macallinkaaga wuxuu fasalka sheeko kooxda u diraa fariintan.

선생님: "발표 자료는 금요일 전까지 메일로 보내 주세요. 파일 이름에는 이름을 꼭 써 주세요."

Waxaad qorsheysaa inaad dhammayso slides-kaaga Jimce subaxnimo.
n-k-k5-04.thinking.0: Ogaanshaha xadka waqtiga ee aan caddayn
n-k-k5-04.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan maalmaha usbuuca iyo taariikhaha
n-k-k5-04.prereq.1: Wuxuu la kulmay 전에 / -까지 iyo hadal edeb leh ama ixtiraam leh oo loo adeegsado macallin
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.prompt: Waxaad qorshaysay inaad dhammayso slaydhadaada subaxda Jimcaha. Kahor intaadan go'aansan, su'aasha kee ayaa ugu waxtar badan inaad macallinka weydiiso?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.0: Si tartiib ah u akhri weedha waqtiga kama dambaysta ah. Erayga kee ayaa laga akhrin karaa laba siyaabood?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.1: Su'aalahee ayaa beddeli lahaa waxaad sameyn subaxda Jimcaha?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.a: Tirada slaydhadu ma aha arrinta; fariintu waxay furan tahay su'aal kale.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.b: Fariintu horeyba waxay kuu sheegtay waxa lagu qoro magaca faylka.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.d: Maanta waa Isniin 11월 2일, sidaa darteed Jimcuhu horeyba waa la ogyahay (11월 6일).
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.e: Tani waxay u qaadanaysaa in diristu Jimcaha la oggol yahay. Taasi waa sida saxda ah ee fariintu aysan u caddayn.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.explain: '금요일 전까지' waxay ula jeedi kartaa 'ilaa maalinta Jimcaha ka horreysa' ama 'ilaa Jimce'. Macallinka keliya ayaa ogaan kara kee ah, sidaa darteed su'aasha waxtarka leh waxay weydiisaa haddii Jimcuhu laftiisu tirsanayo.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.acc.0: Macallin ku jawaabaya 'ilaa waqtigee Jimcaha' ayaa xalin lahaa xagga ficilka, laakiin su'aashu marka hore ma hubiso haddii Jimcuhu tirsanayo.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.prompt: Qor su'aashaada macallinka Kuuriyaan (hadal edeb leh oo ixtiraam leh). Sheeg waqtiga kama dambaysta ah oo si cad u dheh waxaad rabto inaad xaqiijiso.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sheeg erayada waqtiga kama dambaysta ah ee macallinka, kadibna dheh maalinta aadan hubin.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.1: Macallinka ku salaan (선생님) oo ku dhammee hadal -요 ama -ㅂ니다.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma su'aashaydu waxay muujisaa inaan arko laba akhris oo suurtagal ah?
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma macallinku ku jawaabi karaa hal weedh gaaban?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.prompt: Macallinka wuxuu ku jawaabay: '아, 금요일 오전 9시까지요.' Maxay u mudatay in la weydiiyo?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig waxaad u qaadatay kahor intaadan weydiin iyo jawaabta aad hesho.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.hint.1: Isweydii: fasal-wadaage macquul ah ma akhriyi karay fariinta si kale?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.a: Macallinka wuxuu khalad ku qoray maalinta oo wuxuu ula jeeday Arbaco.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.a: Fariinta waxba kuma tilmaamaan Arbaco, jawaabtuna waxay bixisaa waqti kama dambays ah oo Jimce ah.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.b: Khamiis iyo Jimce labaduba waxay ahaayeen akhris caddaalad ah, sidaa darteed macallinka oo keliya ayaa xalin kari lahaa.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.c: '전까지' had iyo jeer waxay ka tagtaa maalinta la magacaabay, sidaa darteed Khamiis ayaa ahayd maalinta ugu dambaysay.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.c: Jawaabtu waxay muujisaa in subaxda Jimcaha la oggolaa, hadlayaal badanna waxay isticmaalaan '전까지' si dabacsan. Maaha xeer go'an.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.d: '까지' had iyo jeer waxay ku dartaa maalinta la magacaabay, sidaa darteed Jimcaha waa la oggolaa bilowga.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.d: Haddii taasi had iyo jeer run ahaan lahayd su'aal looma baahnayn; jawaabtu waxay sidoo kale ku daraysaa waqti (오전 9시) fariintu aysan weligeed bixin.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.explain: Isla weedhu waxay ula jeedi kartaa 'ilaa Khamiis' ama 'ilaa Jimce'. Akhrinteeda hal siyaabood oo keliya waxay khatar gelin lahayd fayl daahsan. Jawaabtu waxay sidoo kale ku daraysaa waqti (오전 9시) fariintu aysan weligeed bixin.

n-k-k5-05.title: Laga bilaabo sheekaysi saaxiibo ilaa ogeysiis wiish
n-k-k5-05.goal: Dib u qor fariin sheekaysi dad aan la aqoon, adigoo ku darraya macluumaadka saaxiibadu horeyba wadaagaan oo beddelaya heerka hadalka.
n-k-k5-05.material:
Adiga iyo saaxiibkaa guriga la wada deggan waxaad qabanaysaan xaflad guri-furasho (집들이) gurigiinna 502호 Sabtida soo socota, 10월 24일, laga bilaabo 6 ilaa 9 p.m. Waxaad ku qortay sheekaysiga saaxiibadaa:

"토욜 저녁에 우리집 파티함ㅋㅋ 좀 시끄러울 듯. 이해 ㄱㄱ"

(ㅋㅋ = qosol, ㄱㄱ = 'tag / ok', 토욜 = 토요일.) Hadda waxaad rabtaa inaad ogeysiis ku dhejiso wiishka deriskaaga. Badankood way ka weyn yihiin, badankoodna ma aadan kulmin.
n-k-k5-05.thinking.0: Xukunka waxa akhristaha cusub aanu ogayn
n-k-k5-05.thinking.1: Doorashada heer hadal dad aan la aqoon oo da'yaal kala duwan ah
n-k-k5-05.prereq.1: Wuxuu la kulmay 양해, 죄송, 부탁 ama wuxuu ka baran karaa tilmaamaha
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.prompt: Saaxiibadu way ogyihiin halka aad ku nooshahay iyo goorta xafladdu tahay. Deriska aan weligood kula kulmin ma ogaan. Waxyaabaha kee ayaa ogeysiiska wiishku u baahan yahay inuu ku daro? Dooro dhammaan kuwa khuseeya.
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir akhrinta fariinta sheekaysiga sida deris: maxaad weli ogaan lahayn?
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.hint.1: Deriska waxaa laga yaabaa inay ka xanaaqaan dhawaaqa. Maxay rabaan inay kaa maqlaan?
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.o.b: Goorta xafladdu bilaabmayso iyo goorta ay dhammaanayso
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.o.c: Cunto iyo cabitaan noocee ah ayaa la bixin doonaa
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.r.c: Deriska uma baahna cuntada si ay u fahmaan ogeysiiska.
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.r.e: Magacyada martida deriska waxtar uma laha.
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.explain: Deriska waa inay ogaadaan yaa dhawaaqa sameynaya (guriga), intee la'eg (waqtiga bilowga iyo dhammaadka) iyo inaad ixtiraamaysid (raalli-galin iyo codsi). Cuntada iyo liiska martidu waxay xiiseeyaan saaxiibada oo keliya.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.prompt: Fasal-wadaage ayaa qoray qabyo koowaad oo ogeysiiska ah. Hal sadar ayaa ku habboonayn deris aadan aqoon, oo ay ku jiraan dadka da'da weyn. Dooro.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.hint.0: Sadar kasta akhri sida deris da' weyn. Kee ayaa u egtahay inuu ka yimid saaxiib?
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.hint.1: Eeg sida codsiyada kale ee qabyada loogu qoray.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.explain: Sadarka 4 wuxuu deriska waxbaa weydiistaa si caadi ah oo saaxiibtinimo leh ('이해해 줘요'). Dadka aadan aqoon waxaad ku weydiisaa '주세요 / 주시면 감사하겠습니다', tusaale '이해해 주시면 감사하겠습니다'.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.prompt: Hadda adigu qor ogeysiiska oo dhan Kuuriyaan loogu talagalay wiishka. Ku dar gurigaaga, waqtiyada bilowga iyo dhammaadka, iyo raalli-galin ama codsi fahmitaan. Isticmaal hadal edeb leh oo qaabka ogeysiiska ah.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ku bilow salaan iyo gurigaaga, sida ogeysiis dhab ah.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.hint.1: Xaqiiqooyinka (goorma, maxay) ku dhig hal weedh, kadibna raalli-galinta weedha xigta.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma deris weligiis ila kulmin wuu ogaan lahaa guriga kuwo ah iyo goorta uu dhammaanayo?
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma codsigaygu wuxuu u egyahay ixtiraam qof da' weyn?
